examples.english: Nobody dares to make a prediction, but will venture to guess that it will be a crisis that won't just last a few months. The problem is that when it rains, it pours.

examples.text: Nadie se atreve a pronosticarlo, pero sí a aventurar que no será una crisis de unos meses. El problema es que llueve sobre mojado.
examples.translation: Nobody dares to make a prediction, but will venture to guess that it will be a crisis that won't just last a few months. The problem is that when it rains, it pours.
